items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admits affair as company launches investigation into foreign spy claims
items.brief: Nvidia chief Jensen Huang has admitted to having an extramarital affair as his company announced it will investigate concerns he was the “target of a foreign intelligence effort” by China.

items.title: Former NYPD officer and teacher’s aide arrested in fatal stabbing of New York City jogger
items.brief: A teacher’s aide who briefly worked as a New York City police officer has been charged with murder in connection with the fatal stabbing of a jogger, according to court documents.

items.title: Joe Biden says cancer will limit him from promoting his upcoming memoir
items.brief: Former President Joe Biden announced Sunday that he “won’t be able to do as many conversations” about his upcoming presidential memoir due to his fight with prostate cancer .

items.title: Pope Leo urges President Milei, a Trump ally, to ‘safeguard democracy’ on arrival in Argentina
items.brief: Pope Leo XIV has called on Argentine President Javier Milei and the country’s political leaders to “safeguard democracy” and demonstrate a “careful use of words” during his first speech in Buenos Aires.
